description: This file defines data models related to sports match information, including teams, scores, highlights, and match details, with public interfaces indicated by comments.

classes.name: Team
classes.description: Represents a sports team with a display name and optional logo URL.

classes.name: Score
classes.description: Encapsulates scores for home and away teams.

classes.name: Highlight
classes.description: Contains optional highlight video information, including title and URL.

classes.name: Match
classes.description: Aggregates match details, including participating teams, scores, status, and optional highlights.
